finding: Eldorado instructions require hot-water soaking at least two hours, changed water and covered boiling with salt. Garant instructions specify covered simmering 25–30 minutes with 500 ml per 100 g. Those are different procedures from the measured research. Do not silently label research output as observed output of these SKU instructions. The study cleaning denominator also differs from purchased gross dry mass.
next: Review compatible source/procedure and gross-to-cleaned estimate before issuing new recipe versions. Extend the existing ledger to measured dry input, cleaned dry mass, actual water and cooked drained output, with no inferred dry-nutrient retention. Preserve all original recipes.
